# Chappleboim et al. 2022 (GSE196937) -- decay rate fitting from 4tU time course
# Strains: Not1-AID (aa91), XRN1-AID (nf227), CCR4-AID (aa118),
#           Pop2-AID (aa81, aa82), Pap2-AID (aa100), dcp2-AID (aa40)
# WT control: nf164
# Method: T>C conversion rate per gene per timepoint, exponential decay fit
# Output: tables/df_chappleboim_hl_gba.txt
#         figures/Chappleboim_decay_scatter.png

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "/Users/caitlinwaterworth/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversityofBath/YM_combined_analysis/EU_combined_analysis")
library(tidyverse)
library(nls.multstart)
library(patchwork)

col_small <- "#784283"
col_large <- "#ffa8cb"
col_A    <- "#e5000c"

load("scripts/gba_functions.rda")
```

```{r load-metadata}
df_samples <- read_csv("tables/GSE196937_samples.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
df_fc      <- read_tsv("output_tables/df_WT_consensus_hl_fc.txt",
                       show_col_types = FALSE)

# Target strains
target_strains <- c("aa91", "nf227", "aa118", "aa81", "aa82", "aa100", "aa40", "nf164")

# Strain to factor name mapping
strain_labels <- c(
  aa91  = "Not1_AID",
  nf227 = "Xrn1_AID",
  aa118 = "CCR4_AID",
  aa81  = "Pop2_AID_a",
  aa82  = "Pop2_AID_b",
  aa100 = "Pap2_AID",
  aa40  = "dcp2_AID",
  nf164 = "WT"
)

# Get sample IDs for target strains with their metadata
df_sample_meta <- df_samples %>%
  filter(strain %in% target_strains) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, strain, iaa_time) %>%
  mutate(condition = strain_labels[strain])

cat("Target samples:", nrow(df_sample_meta), "\n")
cat("Conditions:", paste(unique(df_sample_meta$condition), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r load-tc-data}
# Load and filter tc_data to target samples only
# Aggregate T>C and T counts per gene per sample (sum across reads)
cat("Loading tc_data -- this will take ~40 seconds...\n")

df_tc <- read_csv("tables/GSE196937_tc_data.csv",
                  show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(sample %in% df_sample_meta$sample) %>%
  select(gene_id = 7, sample = 6, tc = 3, t = 4) %>%
  group_by(gene_id, sample) %>%
  summarise(tc = sum(tc, na.rm = TRUE),
            t  = sum(t,  na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

cat("Aggregated rows:", nrow(df_tc), "\n")
```

```{r compute-conversion-rates}
# Join with sample metadata to get strain and time point
# Calculate T>C conversion rate = tc / t
# Require minimum 20 T counts for reliable rate estimation

df_rates <- df_tc %>%
  inner_join(df_sample_meta, by = "sample") %>%
  filter(t >= 20) %>%
  mutate(tc_rate = tc / t)

cat("Gene-sample observations after T filter:", nrow(df_rates), "\n")
```

```{r normalise}
# Normalise conversion rate to t=0 for each gene per condition
# tc_rate_norm = tc_rate(t) / tc_rate(t=0)
# This gives the fraction of labelled RNA remaining at each timepoint

df_t0 <- df_rates %>%
  filter(iaa_time == 0) %>%
  group_by(gene_id, condition) %>%
  summarise(tc_rate_t0 = mean(tc_rate, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

df_rates_norm <- df_rates %>%
  filter(iaa_time > 0) %>%
  inner_join(df_t0, by = c("gene_id", "condition")) %>%
  mutate(tc_rate_norm = tc_rate / tc_rate_t0) %>%
  filter(is.finite(tc_rate_norm), tc_rate_norm > 0)

cat("Gene-timepoint observations after normalisation:", nrow(df_rates_norm), "\n")
```

```{r fit-decay}
# Fit exponential decay per gene per condition
# model: tc_rate_norm = exp(-k * iaa_time)
# half-life = log(2) / k

fit_decay <- function(df) {
  tryCatch({
    fit <- nls_multstart(
      tc_rate_norm ~ exp(-k * iaa_time),
      data          = df,
      iter          = 100,
      start_lower   = c(k = 0.001),
      start_upper   = c(k = 2),
      supp_errors   = "Y"
    )
    tibble(k = coef(fit)[["k"]],
           half_life = log(2) / coef(fit)[["k"]])
  }, error = function(e) {
    tibble(k = NA_real_, half_life = NA_real_)
  })
}

cat("Fitting decay curves -- this may take several minutes...\n")

df_fits <- df_rates_norm %>%
  group_by(gene_id, condition) %>%
  filter(n() >= 4) %>%
  group_modify(~fit_decay(.x)) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Genes with fits:", nrow(df_fits), "\n")
cat("Conditions:\n")
df_fits %>% dplyr::count(condition) %>% print()
```

```{r compute-fc}
# Calculate fold change vs WT for each condition
# log2FC = log2(hl_condition / hl_WT)

df_wt_hl <- df_fits %>%
  filter(condition == "WT") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, hl_wt = half_life)

# Average Pop2_AID replicates
df_fc_chapp <- df_fits %>%
  filter(condition != "WT") %>%
  mutate(condition = case_when(
    condition %in% c("Pop2_AID_a", "Pop2_AID_b", "Pap2_AID") ~ "Pop2_AID",
    TRUE ~ condition
  )) %>%
  group_by(gene_id, condition) %>%
  summarise(half_life = mean(half_life, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  inner_join(df_wt_hl, by = "gene_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(half_life), !is.na(hl_wt),
         is.finite(half_life), is.finite(hl_wt),
         hl_wt > 0, half_life > 0) %>%
  mutate(log2FC_hl = log2(half_life / hl_wt)) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, condition, log2FC_hl) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition,
              values_from = log2FC_hl,
              names_prefix = "log2FC_hl_")

cat("Genes in FC table:", nrow(df_fc_chapp), "\n")
colnames(df_fc_chapp)
```

```{r plot-qc}
# QC scatter: each condition HL FC vs WT_hl_fc
df_plot <- df_fc_chapp %>%
  inner_join(df_fc, by = "gene_id")

cat("Genes after merging with WT hl FC:", nrow(df_plot), "\n")

fc_cols <- colnames(df_fc_chapp)[-1]

plots <- map(fc_cols, function(col) {
  r_val <- cor(df_plot[[col]], df_plot$WT_hl_fc,
               method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
  n_val <- sum(!is.na(df_plot[[col]]) & !is.na(df_plot$WT_hl_fc))
  
  cat(col, "vs WT_hl_fc R:", round(r_val, 3), "n:", n_val, "\n")
  
  ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = .data[[col]], y = WT_hl_fc)) +
    geom_point(colour = col_large, alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(colour = "black", se = FALSE, span = 0.4) +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5,
             label = paste0("R = ", round(r_val, 3)),
             size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 3.2,
             label = paste0("n = ", format(n_val, big.mark = ",")),
             size = 4, colour = "grey40") +
    labs(x = paste0("log2 HL FC after ", gsub("log2FC_hl_", "", col),
                    " (Chappleboim, fitted)"),
         y = "log2 half-life FC (large / small cells)") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 11, colour = "black"),
          axis.text  = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"))
})

p_panel <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 3)
p_panel
ggsave("figures/Chappleboim_decay_scatter.png", p_panel,
       width = 18, height = 12, dpi = 150)
cat("Saved figures/Chappleboim_decay_scatter.png\n")
```

cat("Saved tables/df_chappleboim_hl_gba.txt\n")
